text: 据中国工程机械工业协会对挖掘机主要制造企业统计，2026年10月销售各类挖掘机20225台，同比增长11.8%。其中：国内销量9501台（含电动挖掘机183台），同比增长12.2%；出口10724台（含电动挖掘机104台），同比增长11.4%。
text_en: According to statistics from the China Construction Machinery Association on major excavator manufacturers, 20,225 excavators of various types were sold in October 2026, up 11.8% year on year. Of these: domestic sales were 9,501 units (including 183 electric excavators), up 12.2% year on year; exports were 10,724 units (including 104 electric excavators), up 11.4% year on year.
